docs/meri-figma-34-20261015/FIGMA-MOCKUP-HANDOFF.md and AUDIT.md. These notes answer the design ambiguities in item 8 and record the added lane gaps.

SOURCES AND CURRENT MEMORY
05.01 defines exactly three contributing sources: Public funding update, Restoration request (TASK-2047), and Strategy review. Counts and related artifact references now agree with those three. The lane’s undefined additional sources are not promoted into the design. Retrieved evidence can still be partial.
Current memory means currently eligible governed recall. Pending, rejected, withdrawn, revoked and superseded records are excluded. A current personal preference may appear alongside client memory. Freshness is separate from authority; stale or controlling conflicted memory can remain eligible only where policy permits. History has its own view.

MEMORY PROPOSALS AND REVIEW AUTHORITY
Submitted proposals remain pending and do not replace the canonical fact. Loading, submission, review, rejection, changes requested, permission, stale-review and error states are explicit. Jordan Clayton cannot approve their own shared-memory proposal. The original 06.02 is the proposer view; 06.02A is explicitly another authorized reviewer’s perspective. Approval covers only the displayed revision and scope. An uncertain write outcome uses a status read, not an automatic repeated write.

REFERENCE AND ROUTINE CONSISTENCY
TP-2048 is the immutable task proposal; TASK-2048 is its created task; TASK-2047 is the distinct source task. Task and filing decisions retain their original payload and have separate recorded outcomes. Routine Active, Paused, Automatically disabled and Cancelled states are separate views. The edit form saves an existing routine. Each historical output is identified by its run date as well as its version. Next-run previews follow the selected schedule.

03.10 MODALITY DECISION
03.10 is the full-page advanced revision form with the verification process alongside it. Its form is intentionally inline, rather than a second modal inside a page. The quick contextual revision UI remains the existing document suggestion overlay (Document overlay · revision, 1064:150603). Both preserve prior versions and require explicit review before applying a suggestion.

SUGGESTION RETRY IS AN EXISTING INLINE STATE
The desktop and mobile Try again controls already change the suggested revision variable 532:122220. Both visible suggestion bodies are bound to that variable. Retry updates the suggestion in place; Replace selection or Insert below is still a separate explicit action. A new navigation frame is unnecessary for this interaction.

BROWSER, SHARING AND RETENTION
Public and authenticated download receipts are separate. Connected-account status is checked after provider sign-in; credentials are never entered into Meri. No browser takeover or device bridge is introduced. Artifact version v2 retains all contributing source scopes. A blocked broader share can request review (AR-1042), but the request itself grants no access and files no copy. Filing cannot strip provenance or expand source permissions. Retention, deletion and session states preserve only currently permitted content and receipts.

INTERACTION COVERAGE
Document Versions and Sources, spreadsheet Source data and References, web Activity, brief pages 2–4, deck slides 2–6, history filters and empty results, source loading and read errors, comment Reply/Resolve/Reopen, and the closed and empty scope/command states have explicit prototype behavior. A zero-result view never proves absence. Copy unavailable is a recoverable clipboard state. Keyboard shortcuts open 09.07. All additional states use shared Capiro components and editable text, with chapter anchors.

IMPLEMENTATION BOUNDARY
These are design and prototype states. The handoff AUDIT lists backend services and adapters that remain unconnected. A frontend implementation must reverify current API contracts, permissions and qualification before enabling actions; a successful Figma interaction is not proof of a connected service. Unavailable services must not substitute synthetic records.
